reason: This would be a proxy sitting directly in our trade path, and it comes from a vendor with no customers, no references and no SOC 2. It would never get through our vendor-risk review, and our agent volume is tiny today, so nobody on the risk committee is going to push it through anyway.
objection: Making an unaudited startup a choke point in front of every agent trade and payment. If it goes down or gets compromised, it's our venue and our license on the line. Even the free pilot means putting it in the trade path and signing a letter of intent and a reference before I've seen an audit.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II report plus two references from regulated brokers or crypto venues already running it in production, and agent order flow on our platform that's big enough for the committee to care about.
